display_name: Gens ace G-tech GEA406S60X9GT 6S 4000 mAh (estimated electrical law)
class_note: Product mass, box and label are approximate manufacturer specifications. The BAK/Galeotti cell curve and class resistance anchor are borrowed estimates, not measurements of this pack.

resistance_scale.source: Class anchor R0 = 5.0 mOhm per cell at 3.2 Ah (50 % SOC, 298.15 K), scaled by 3.2 Ah / rated capacity (same cell design family, R ∝ 1/Q). Anchor estimated from: Bauersfeld & Scaramuzza 2022 (arXiv 2109.04741, IEEE RA-L 7(2):2953, Table I R_min = 4.5 mOhm per cell, 1.8 Ah 4S racing pack); Di Nisio et al. 2023 (Sensors 23:6937, doi:10.3390/s23156937: 20.68 mOhm for a 4S 10 Ah pack = 5.2 mOhm per cell); PX4 battery docs ('a typical value for LiPo batteries is 5mOhm per cell'). Never derived from the C label. resistance_scale = 5.0 mOhm·3.2 Ah / (reference capacity 1.02504 Ah · template R0(0.5, 298.15 K) 115.227 mOhm); the RC branches scale by the same factor

interconnect_resistance_ohm.source: Estimated 2 mOhm for pack leads and XT90-class connection; not measured for this pack or installation

dimensions_m.source: https://gensace.de/products/gea406s60x9gt (GEA406S60X9GT, checked 2026-11-08): approximately 162 x 45 x 37 mm

still_air_w_per_k.source: h_nat·A with h_nat = 5 W/(m²·K) (Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Table 1.1: free convection of gases 2–25 W/(m²·K)) and A = 0.029898 m² from the manufacturer-specified approximate box

forced_w_per_k_per_sqrt_mps.source: A·0.664·k·Pr^(1/3)/sqrt(ν·L): laminar flat-plate average Nusselt number Nu_L = 0.664·Re_L^0.5·Pr^(1/3) (Incropera & DeWitt eq. 7.30) with air at 300 K k = 0.0263 W/(m·K), ν = 15.89e-6 m²/s, Pr = 0.707 (Table A.4), L = pack length 0.1620 m; installation airflow not included

label.source: https://gensace.de/products/gea406s60x9gt (GEA406S60X9GT, checked 2026-11-08): 60C label, informative only; not a current limit
